categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the manufacturing and sales of aluminum alloy components for new energy vehicle battery systems. The main business segment is the production and sale of battery box housings, which are critical components of new energy vehicle power battery systems. The company also develops related products including battery cell shells and precision structural components that support the battery system integration.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company possesses advanced aluminum alloy material research capabilities, digital full-process extrusion control technology, and advanced FSW (Friction Stir Welding) welding technology. The company utilizes aluminum alloy extrusion processes and innovative manufacturing techniques to produce lightweight, high-strength battery box housings. The company has established a complete business system encompassing aluminum alloy material research and development, product design, advanced production processes, and large-scale manufacturing.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company's primary customers are major new energy vehicle manufacturers and power battery manufacturers, including BYD, Geely Automobile, CATL (Contemporary Amperex Technology Co., Limited), CITIC New Aviation, and other leading enterprises in the new energy vehicle industry. The company serves the pure electric vehicle (BEV), plug-in hybrid electric vehicle (PHEV), and hybrid electric vehicle (HEV) markets, covering mainstream technology routes in the global new energy vehicle sector.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in mainland China, with major manufacturing facilities located in Chongqing (Fuling District and Nanchuan District) and Anhui Province (Wuwei). The company's headquarters and main production operations are based in Chongqing's Fuling District, with additional production capacity being developed in Nanchuan District and Wuwei to support regional market demands and customer proximity.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream to downstream segments of the new energy vehicle supply chain. As a Tier-1 supplier of critical battery system components, the company sits between raw material suppliers (aluminum ingot and alloy material suppliers) and original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) and battery pack integrators, providing essential structural and protective components for battery systems.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company's strategic focus includes developing next-generation integrated battery box technologies compatible with CTP (Cell-to-Pack) and CTC (Cell-to-Body) battery system architectures, advancing lightweight and high-strength aluminum alloy materials, and enhancing thermal management capabilities through integrated liquid cooling solutions. The company is investing in platform-based product development, precision manufacturing processes, and automation to improve production efficiency and reduce costs while maintaining technological leadership in battery system integration.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through direct sales of aluminum alloy battery box housings and related components to new energy vehicle manufacturers and battery pack integrators. The company employs a consignment sales model with major customers, where products are placed in customer warehouses and revenue is recognized upon actual usage confirmation. The company also generates revenue from the sale of scrap aluminum materials produced during manufacturing processes.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading domestic manufacturer of new energy vehicle battery box housings, having established itself as the primary supplier to BYD for aluminum alloy battery box components. The company competes with other aluminum component manufacturers and traditional steel-based suppliers in the battery system component market. The company's competitive advantages include advanced manufacturing technology, established customer relationships, quality consistency, and integrated design-to-production capabilities.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company achieved operating revenue of approximately 1.906 billion yuan in 2024, representing 6.95% growth compared to 2023 revenue of 1.782 billion yuan. Net profit attributable to parent company shareholders was 192.89 million yuan in 2024, with a net profit margin of approximately 10.1%. Total assets reached 3.242 billion yuan as of December 31, 2024, representing 46.1% growth from the prior year, reflecting significant expansion in production capacity and working capital.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through advanced aluminum alloy extrusion and FSW welding technologies that enable lightweight, high-strength battery box designs with superior thermal management capabilities. The company's products support multiple battery system integration technologies (CTM, CTP, CTB/CTC) and offer integrated solutions combining structural strength, thermal dissipation, and weight reduction. The company's established relationships with leading OEMs and battery manufacturers, combined with proven quality and reliability, provide significant switching costs and competitive moats in the market.
